thread:
maria: Customer just confirmed they need an on‑prem POC in a fully isolated datacenter. No egress allowed. They asked whether we can do USB-based bundle delivery + signed delta updates. timeline: 4 weeks. pricing/ops questions incoming.

alex: ok — we do this but there are tradeoffs. key Qs: how many nodes, expected update cadence, and will they accept a jumpbox for remote troubleshooting?

jordan: short answer: yes, we can support USB-delivered bundles + delta patching. propose: initial full bundle (signed, SBOM, manifest v2) + periodic signed delta-chunks applied with our delta-apply tool.

samir: security checklist up front: HSM/KMS integration requirement? FIPS/AAL requirements? do they need attestations for each bundle (sig chain + timestamp)?

maria: they want HSM-backed keys on their side, quarterly cert rotation, and a security questionnaire will arrive tomorrow. also they asked about a non‑recurring packaging fee vs a monthly offline-support fee.

alex: commercial suggestion: 1) one‑time offline packaging & signing fee (covers SBOM, manifest, testing) 2) per-node annual license 3) optional on‑call/remote assist retainer (monthly) because jumpbox windows add ops cost. rough numbers pending legal.

jordan: technical runbook (high level):
1) exchange MOU + IP allowlist for jumpbox (if accepted)
2) produce signed full bundle v1.0 + SBOM and test vectors
3) customer verifies sha256/GPG sig locally (we provide verification script)
4) run POC smoke tests (we provide test harness)
5) prepare delta bundles for patches (signed, chunked) and provide delta-apply binary + checksums
6) sign off and handover runbook + cert rotation steps

jordan: sample verification snippet to include in POC docs:
```
# verify bundle checksum and GPG signature
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle-v1.tar.gz
gpg --verify redwood-offline-bundle-v1.tar.gz.sig redwood-offline-bundle-v1.tar.gz
```

alex: also flag: if they insist zero remote access, we need to ship time-limited activation tokens embedded in the bundle and a one-time manual validation step. that increases ops by ~2 days per release.

samir: on cert rotation: customer wants quarterly rotation but offline sites may not want frequent physical ops. propose: allow 12-month certs by default and offer a scripted rotation that can be run offline with their HSM. document the attestation flow.

maria: POC acceptance criteria from customer: 1) SLO: 100ms median RPC for inference within isolated DC (on their GPUs), 2) successful bundle verification and run of our smoke harness, 3) ability to accept a signed delta and apply without internet, 4) documented rollback.

jordan: rollback approach: keep previous bundle snapshot + delta revert metadata. delta-apply supports reverse-apply if we keep old chunk hashes. we'll include a small CLI: `redwood-delta revert --bundle metadata.json`.

alex: ops/maintenance cadence question for pricing: do they want quarterly delta windows or ad-hoc emergency patches? those change MRR vs one-time fees.

maria: they prefer quarterly scheduled updates, plus paid emergency patches. ask finance for two price bands.

shipbot: deploy-bundler: offline-bundle v1.0 created and signed (manifest id: mfst-20260308-7f3a) :package:

samir: one more security note — we must provide a repeatable verification process for their auditors: signed SBOM + provenance chain, plus PSO that lists what we ship on USB. include hash tree for bundle pieces.

jordan: action items: alex to draft commercial two-band pricing; samir to draft security appendix for questionnaire; i (jordan) to prepare POC runbook + verification scripts; maria to coordinate dates with customer and request the questionnaire now.

maria: timeline aim: sample bundle to their lab by 2026-03-22, POC run finished 2 weeks after that.

alex: ack. will post pricing draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

samir: ping me if the questionnaire has special controls (SC-12 etc). I'll map responses to our control docs.

maria: thanks — i'll request the questionnaire now and loop in procurement.

alex: one last note — we should clarify SLA for evidence retention and debug logs because offline sites may require longer retention windows (we can offer +90 days export as add-on).

jordan: yep — include in SOW: log export, long-term storage export instructions, and a signed acceptance checklist.

maria: perfect. i'll compile and send to customer.
